news.title: Fake cash, stolen bike: Tennessee man claims he was scammed in DeKalb County
news.summary: He said he was conned out of $12,000 while trying to sell his Suzuki GSX-R600 motorcycle on Facebook Marketplace.

news.title: Austell railyard murder arrest: Third suspect captured in Florida
news.summary: Escambia County sheriff's deputies arrested 27-year-old Ty Anthony Thompson in Florida in connection with a fatal railyard shooting.

news.title: Third suspect in shooting of Norfolk Southern contractor near railway property arrested out of state
news.summary: Cobb County Police said the Escambia County Sheriff's Office in Florida arrested 27-year-old Ty Anthony Thompson on Thursday.

news.title: Cross-state search ends with 19-year-old arrested in Tucker killing
news.summary: Gwinnett County police announced a Tucker homicide arrest after capturing a 19-year-old man wanted in a fatal shooting on Preston Lake Drive.

news.title: Judge sentences 71-year-old Canton man to life in child sex abuse case
news.summary: A 71-year-old Canton man received a life sentence in prison for sex crimes involving a child under 10 years old in Cherokee County.

news.title: Pedestrian struck by vehicle on Candler Road in DeKalb County
news.summary: A vehicle struck a male pedestrian at the intersection of Candler Road and Glenwood Road in DeKalb County on Thursday morning.

news.title: Bullet holes left behind after gunfire strikes DeKalb homes, car
news.summary: DeKalb County police are investigating a report of shots fired in the 1500 block of Eastern Sunrise Lane early Thursday morning.

news.title: Man wanted for metro Atlanta killing arrested in Florida
news.summary: A suspect has been arrested in south Alabama in connection with a metro Atlanta homicide.

news.title: A grandmother was shot while donating food. Now she’s unable to walk
news.summary: Dorothy Gordon, 75, says she was passing out food at the Chevron on Washington Road in East Point in July when someone shot her in the back.

news.title: 2 students arrested for bringing weapon to DeKalb County high school, principal says
news.summary: According to the school's principal, police arrested the two students, who will face both legal and disciplinary consequences.

news.title: 19-year-old deadly shooting suspect arrested; police say he was tracked by Flock
news.summary: A 19-year-old has been arrested in connection with a deadly shooting that happened over the weekend, Gwinnett County Police Department said.

news.title: Metro Atlanta man arrested in connection with shooting of former Ga. Tech, 49ers player Keion White
news.summary: White was shot in the ankle while hosting a private party at a nightclub in San Francisco following the Super Bowl on February 9, 2026, police said.
